Startupový fond Czech Founders VC otevírá další kolo přihlášek.

Startup Maxifusion vyvíjí platformu pro automatizovanou tvorbu videoreklam a teď hlásí i získání investice 350 tisíc eur (8,4 milionu korun) od Czech Founders VC, andělského investora i samotných zakladatelů.
Kolo vedl fond Reflex Capital za účasti Czech Founders VC a Lighthouse Ventures.
Backed by Rockaway Ventures and Czech Founders VC, Cruxo has secured funding to expand internationally.

Všichni zde zmínění složili dohromady deset milionů eur, přibližně čtvrt miliardy korun, které chce nový hráč v následujících čtyřech letech vložit do asi padesátky startupů v nejranějších fázích jejich vývoje.
Protože trojice zakladatelů viděla, jak mezi úspěšnými startupisty zájem o účast na podobném projektu rezonuje, rozhodli se nakonec cílovou částku zdvojnásobit na deset milionů eur.

analyst_notes: Ticket and stage from the investor's homepage focus block ('Pre-seed tickets. Typically €50-350k.'); CzechCrunch 2025-02-05 adds the Sherpa acceleration programme with an initial investment of about CZK 1m and follow-on up to about CZK 6m (the accelerator is part of the VC, so the accelerator flag is not set). Sector focus derived from cited portfolio companies (Maxfusion - AI video-ad platform, Merchantee - AI tools for marketplace sellers, Cruxo - retail-media SaaS); the site states no sector focus. Capital (fund size) not disclosed in the sources reviewed. Merchantee round amount is the CZK 30m seed extension (whole round). Maxfusion: CzechCrunch spells it 'Maxifusion' in the body and 'Maxfusion' in the headline. Distinct from United Founders, a new fund of Jakub Havrlant and Vít Horký (CzechCrunch 2025-11-04; CZK 430m committed, target in billions) - the Czech Founders VC homepage announces it ('We've launched United Founders!'); United Founders is not in this pilot list and was not researched further. Statutory body of the fund company: Vít Horký, Václav Pavlečka, Ivan Kristeľ. [revision 2026-10-25 after review: capital filled - was not_disclosed although public: EUR 10m (about CZK 250m) put in by the 45 founder-investors, latest_fund_size as of 2022-09-07 (CzechCrunch 2022-09-07: the initial EUR 5m target was doubled to EUR 10m and fully raised a month before publication, e7-e9); recorded as a final_close fund event dated by the article (the close itself was about August 2022, day not given). No later fund of Czech Founders VC found; United Founders is a separately branded fund (not this record).]
